seoContent.heading: Song-Köl horseback riding from Kyzart: route notes
paragraphs: Kyzart is a practical trailhead for a Song-Köl horse trek. It gives the group time to meet the horseman and match a horse to each rider before moving into the Kilemche Valley.

Song-Köl sits at high altitude, so warm layers, sun protection, closed footwear, and realistic expectations about simple yurt-camp facilities matter. We confirm the camp, road access, and final riding plan before departure rather than promising conditions that depend on the mountains.

faq.question: Do I need previous riding experience?

faq.question: When is this Song-Köl horse tour available?

highlights: A balanced mix of driving, riding, and walking
Nomadic highlands and alpine lake landscapes
Route pacing adapted to the group
Route highlights: Bishkek, Song-Kol Lake, Kel-Suu Lake, Issyk-Kol and Ala-Kol Lake
